mil3.6.5:0.3: The Question on the Ordination of the Buddha
mil3.6.5:1.3: “Yes, Great King, the ordination is beautiful.”
mil3.6.5:1.4: “But, venerable sir, does the Buddha have an ordination, or not?”
mil3.6.5:1.5: “The Blessed One is well ordained, Great King, at the foot of the awakening tree together with full omniscient knowledge. The Blessed One has no ordination given by others; just as, Great King, he teaches his disciples the training rules as not to be transgressed for the rest of their lives.”
mil3.6.5:3.1: The Question on the Ordination of the Buddha: Fifth.
